cohort: The study included 2329 advanced maternal age (>=35 years) primiparous women who delivered singleton pregnancies at Northwest Women's and Children's Hospital between January 2016 and January 2020.
finding: In advanced maternal age primiparous women, Assisted Reproductive Technology (ART) was independently associated with increased risks of preeclampsia, cesarean delivery, preterm birth, and neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) admission.
mod_finding: ART was independently associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery.
